evidence.title: Valor, Point72 back General Intuition at $6B valuation as AI startup pushes into robotics

summary: General Intuition, an artificial‑intelligence company, secured a new financing round led by Valor and Point72, pushing its valuation to $6 billion. The capital will fund the firm’s push into robotics applications, marking a broader move beyond its core AI offerings.
title: AI startup General Intuition raises funding from Valor and Point72, valued at $6 billion, as it expands into robotics
